generated_helpers.purpose: Portable launcher; redirects only the archived tests preflight and baseline-source fixture locations.

purpose: Byte-exact scientific sources for the seven seed-0 ECG-QA experiments; no cloud account or process controllers.

runtime_notes.corpus_configs: The bundled corpus YAML files preserve the original repository-relative dataset, manifest and output paths. Run from a prepared workspace with those paths, or record a relocated copy changing only source.registry, source.manifest, build.cache_dir and build.teacher.store. Keep the manifest logical SHA, build parameters and seed unchanged. Generated corpora in the experiments used diffusets_generate.py prepare rather than the generic example corpus_generated.yaml.
runtime_notes.embedding_preparation: scripts/runpod/diffusets_embeddings.py is the existing local extraction implementation, captured by file SHA here (not independently bound in the collected remote source archive). It extracts the selected reports from the pinned published CSV and verifies the frozen plan and original metadata; it makes no embedding API calls. The frozen plan carries the original absolute metadata CSV path. Restore it or record a separately adapted path mapping; changing the plan changes its checksum.
runtime_notes.exclusions: No checkpoints, raw ECGs, generated signal bundles, cloud credentials, pod/account receipts, process supervisors, queues, guards, collectors, caches or AppleDouble metadata.
runtime_notes.external_dependencies: OpenTSLM source, pretrained model assets, PTB-XL/ECG-QA-CoT data, TimeNet 0.11.0 and timenet-connectors 0.11.0, and frozen prepared datasets/generation bundles are external. Exact observed packages are in each runtime-pip-freeze.txt; baseline requirements are in baseline_runtime/scripts/runpod/requirements.txt. Original CUDA torch was 2.8.0.dev20250319+cu128; open-flamingo 2.0.1 was installed with --no-deps.
runtime_notes.namespace_warning: Use separate generation and training Python environments. syntide is a regular package, so listing both src trees on PYTHONPATH does not merge them. The exact qa_baseline_audit module is copied into the training tree as deployed.
runtime_notes.original_qa_overrides: Only QA build.py differs between the initial QA export archive and the later DiffuSETS frozen source. Apply original_qa_overrides/src into a separate copy of generation_runtime/src to rebuild those original corpora. All other archived QA Python modules, including evidence.py, match the later frozen source; do not overwrite the later DiffuSETS source.
runtime_notes.planner: generation_runtime/planning/build_plan.py is byte-exact historical provenance, with local absolute source paths and output location; it is not a portable fresh-run CLI. Restore the pinned candidate plan for exact generation. Any adapted planner must change paths in a separate copy, record its source/config hashes, and preserve TRAIN/selection-only allocation and slot ordering.
runtime_notes.runner_history: generation_runtime/scripts/runpod contains the originally pinned scripts; executed_full5000 and executed_snapshot3030 preserve the exact later scientific runners. frozen_evaluation.py is the snapshot selection-calibrated continuation. They contain expired absolute deadlines/paths and are archival execution evidence, not fresh cloud launch commands. Reproduction needs new output paths and a separately recorded operational configuration.
runtime_notes.tests: Baseline tests use synthetic data/artifacts. Generation tests use fake generation/evaluation. exposure/run_cpu_tests.py runs the unchanged exposure tests and redirects only their archived preflight and baseline-source fixture lookups to the included scientific files; it does not train or evaluate held-out data.
